name: Recommendation Letter
description: Writes specific, evidence-based recommendation letters for academic, professional, and personal contexts with competency mapping, concrete examples, and credible endorsement structure. Use when the user asks to write a recommendation letter, reference letter, letter of support, or endorsement for a colleague, student, or acquaintance. Do NOT use for cover letters (use career skills), personal references for housing (different format), or self-recommendation (that is a personal statement).
